name: @vaagatech/anvesh-monorepo
description: Anvesh monorepo — engine, hub, indexer, spider, setup by VaagaTech

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vaagatech/anvesh-shared && npm run build -w @vaagatech/anvesh-engine && npm run build -w @vaagatech/anvesh-indexer && npm run build -w @vaagatech/anvesh-spider && npm run build -w @vaagatech/anvesh-hub && npm run build -w @vaagatech/anvesh-setup
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vaagatech/anvesh-engine && npm run test -w @vaagatech/anvesh-spider
scripts.publish:dry: npm run build && npm publish -w @vaagatech/anvesh-shared --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @vaagatech/anvesh-engine --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @vaagatech/anvesh-indexer --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @vaagatech/anvesh-spider --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @vaagatech/anvesh-hub --access public --dry-run && npm publish -w @vaagatech/anvesh-setup --access public --dry-run

author: VaagaTech <info@vaagatech.com>
